ModMetaData.name: Stop farming, it's enough!
ModMetaData.author: "GentleCode"
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically pause sowing and/or harvesting above each crop's upper stock limit, and resume below its lower limit. Reads vanilla map resource statistics every 600 ticks. Includes optional Smart Farming and High Density Hydroponics compatibility.
库存超过各作物上限时自动暂停播种和／或收获，低于下限时恢复。每 600 ticks 读取一次原版地图资源统计。包含 Smart Farming 和 High Density Hydroponics 可选兼容。
